alerts.title: Missing FBS/RBS monitoring on DTG
alerts.message: Guidelines list FBS/RBS as a required laboratory test, especially for adults at risk on DTG. This patient is on DTG since 2022, yet no blood glucose result appears in the available labs. The clinician's plan today does not include ordering FBS/RBS. DTG is associated with metabolic adverse effects including hyperglycaemia, and without a glucose reading this risk cannot be excluded.

evidence.recommended_action: Order FBS or RBS at this visit and document results; repeat periodically per national schedule for patients on DTG.

alerts.title: No LFTs documented for patient on TDF+DTG
alerts.message: Guidelines include LFTs in the routine laboratory schedule for recipients of care. No liver function test results are recorded for this patient, and the clinician's plan does not include ordering LFTs. TDF and DTG both carry potential hepatotoxic risk. Absence of any baseline or follow-up LFT means hepatic adverse effects cannot be detected.

evidence.recommended_action: Order LFTs at this visit if none documented previously; ensure results are reviewed and recorded.
